meta.title: About Blake Oxford | Systems Architect
meta.description: Systems architect helping companies navigate AI, connect platforms, and scale from practical use cases to enterprise adoption.

hero.title: I build the operating middle that strategy slides skip
hero.description: Based in Michigan. I help companies connect AI, platforms, and people—from early use cases to enterprise adoption.
proofPoints: I start with the work people need to get done
I connect new capabilities to the systems teams already use
I plan for ownership, adoption, and ongoing operation

achievements.title: Practical AI, grounded in operating experience
achievements.description: The same discipline that connects finance, cloud platforms, and workflows applies to AI: start with a real need, make it usable, and build for what comes next.

cards.title: Start with the constraint
cards.description: Clarify the business problem before choosing a platform, model, or automation.
achievements: Use cases tied to real decisions and handoffs
Existing systems and data considered early
Clear boundaries for what to automate

cards.title: Make adoption part of the build
cards.description: The work continues after a tool goes live. Teams need a usable workflow and a clear owner.
achievements: AI in the tools people already open
Human review where judgment matters
Operating guidance alongside implementation

cards.title: Build for enterprise scale
cards.description: Enterprise AI needs more than a successful pilot. Integration, access, and ongoing operation have to work together.
achievements: Connections to enterprise platforms
Governance and access designed in
Rollout and adoption treated as connected work

education.title: Finance context. Systems craft. AI in practice.
education.description: A foundation in finance informs how I approach technology: understand the decision, connect the systems, and keep the operating consequences in view.
education.educationDescription: Finance with complementary study in Mandarin Chinese and development economics—modeling, international business, and structured decision-making under constraint.
education.skillsIntro: The capabilities I bring together when a technology decision needs to become a working part of the business.

closing.description: Working out where to begin, or how to scale what already works? Start with the workflow, system, or adoption challenge in front of your team.
